statements: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.synthetic_queries', N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE dbo.synthetic_queries  (id INT PRIMARY KEY, query_pattern NVARCHAR(450), memory_grant INT, parallelism INT)
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.query_execution_logs', N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE dbo.query_execution_logs  (id INT PRIMARY KEY, query_id INT, execution_time_ms INT, wait_type NVARCHAR(64))
